description: This nested donut chart represents the proportions of deception levels across two categories, identified as "Ambiguity 1" and "Ambiguity 2." The chart consists of two concentric rings, each containing three slices, for a total of six distinct segments. Two legends are provided on the right side of the chart to define the color coding for each ring. The outer ring, corresponding to "Ambiguity 1 (Outer)," includes a dark red slice labeled "Deceived" at 67.6%, a gold or dark yellow slice labeled "Partially" at 23.5%, and a dark green slice labeled "Not Deceived" at 8.8%. The inner ring, representing "Ambiguity 2 (Inner)," features a bright red slice for "Deceived" at 57.9%, a bright yellow slice for "Partially" at 31.6%, and a bright green slice for "Not Deceived" at 10.5%. Bold percentage labels are positioned directly inside their respective slices. Visually, the segments in both the inner and outer rings are ordered in descending size in a clockwise direction, starting with the largest "Deceived" category, and no slices are exploded or offset.
